notes.title: Additional unlocking CG condition presentation
notes.content: Updated the way to present conditions for unlocked CGs, and added a difficulty selection box on the character selection interface.

notes.title: 2024/02/08 update
notes.content:
Two additional difficulty levels are available to choose from. 

EASY & HARD Two difficulties. The default difficulty is HARD. 

The difficulty selection is visible in the lower right corner of the level minimap selection.
